name: Indian Institute of Management Shillong

programs.name: Post Graduate Program (PGP) - two-year full-time MBA
programs.feeNote: No 2026-28 fee published. The official finances page lists only the PGP 2024-26 term-wise payments (summing to INR 26,18,000 including caution deposit and mess advances), so no programme fee is recorded.

feeSource.title: IIM Shillong - PGP Finances (Financial aid and fees)
feeSource.quote: PGP 2024-2026 Fee and Expenses Details: Acceptance Fee + caution deposit + advance for mess charges 90,000; Term 1 fees + advance for mess charges 3,63,000; Term 2 ... Term 6 fees + advance for mess charges 4,33,000 (each). [feeTotal 26,18,000 = 90,000 + 3,63,000 + 5 x 4,33,000, computed by summing; it is for the 2024-26 batch (latest published on the official site) and INCLUDES caution deposit and mess advances]

programs.salaryNote: Median CTC, placement completion report for the PGP 2024-26 batch.

salarySource.title: IIM Shillong - Placement Completion Report, PGP 2024-26 Batch
salarySource.quote: The batch recorded an impressive highest CTC of INR 71.50 LPA, with an average CTC of INR 27.03 LPA and median CTC of INR 26.00 LPA

cutoffs.notes: Policy category is 'OTHERS (OT)'. Sectional minimums only; the policy states no minimum overall CAT percentile (shortlisting is then by Composite Score = 65% overall CAT percentile + 35% NARS, by academic discipline/category/gender). Non-CAT: Class X/XII/graduation % feed the application rating score, not a hard cutoff in this document.
